newsitem.title: GERMANY: German air cargo market up 2.7 pct in Feb 97.
newsitem.headline: German air cargo market up 2.7 pct in Feb 97.

text.p: The German air cargo market grew 2.7 percent in February to 160,029 tonnes, figures from the German airports association ADV showed.
Exports rose three percent while imports increased 1.3 percent, the monthly ADV traffic report showed.
But this was lower than in January when the market grew seven percent with a 4.9 percent rise in exports and a 7.5 percent increase in imports, the ADV said.
The strongest growth among major German airports in February was shown by Duesseldorf, Munich and Nuremberg.
But the two largest cargo gateways, Frankfurt and Cologne, rose only 1.1 percent and 1.6 percent respectively.
